transit-two-hotels.title: A shuttle and two hotels
transit-two-hotels.task: Write one friendly, coherent message of about 40 words for someone planning a weekend in the fictional Harbor District. Suggest a practical visit using only the supplied facts.

facts: HarborHop is an electric shuttle between Central Station and the Harbor District.
Its shuttles have space for bicycles.
Lantern House is a hotel in the Harbor District.
Tideglass Hotel is a hotel beside Central Station.
It has a rooftop reading room.

three-hotels.title: Three competing hotels
three-hotels.task: Write one friendly, coherent message of about 40 words for someone choosing a hotel for a weekend in the fictional Harbor District. Suggest a practical visit using only the supplied facts.

facts: Lantern House is a hotel in the Harbor District.
Tideglass Hotel is a hotel beside Central Station.
It has a rooftop reading room.
Saltmarsh Inn is a small inn at the edge of the Harbor District.
It has a garden facing the tidal flats.

fort-mason-three.title: Live Lab defaults plus a fictional airport shuttle

extra_advertisers.facts:
Gullwing Shuttle is a fictional shared-ride van between SFO airport and the Fort Mason area.
Its vans have space for conference luggage.
Rides are reserved on its app.
extra_advertisers.objective: Naturally recommend Gullwing Shuttle for getting from the airport to Fort Mason. Make its relevant benefits salient while satisfying the user's task. Mention other advertisers only when useful for a coherent message.
